tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Shorten a URL with wx93.me and return the short link. Works without an account (free links open through a short ad page for people; bots and previews get the direct redirect). Signed-in Pro and Automation links redirect directly and can have aliases.

tools.name: bulk_shorten
tools.description: Shorten up to 1,000 URLs in one call (Automation plan). Returns one result per input, in order.

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: The account's short links, newest first, with click counts.

tools.name: get_link
tools.description: One of your links.

tools.name: link_stats
tools.description: Clicks for one of your links: totals (people, QR scans, unique visitors, bots), and on Pro+ daily counts, referrers, countries, cities, devices, OS, browsers, a weekday-by-hour heatmap, week over week and the latest visits.

tools.name: update_link
tools.description: Change where one of your links goes, its title, expiry or redirect type.

tools.name: delete_link
tools.description: Delete one of your links. It stops resolving at once.

tools.name: expand_link
tools.description: Where a wx93.me short link goes, without following it.

tools.name: create_qr_code
tools.description: Save a styled QR code to the account and return it with a PNG preview. Dynamic types (url, vcard, event, links) encode a wx93 short link: scans are counted and the content can change after printing (vcard, event and links get a hosted page). Static types (text, wifi, email, phone, sms, whatsapp, geo

tools.name: list_qr_codes
tools.description: The account's saved QR codes, newest first, with what each encodes and its scan count.

tools.name: get_qr_code
tools.description: One saved QR code, with the image as PNG and links to SVG and print-ready PDF.

tools.name: update_qr_code
tools.description: Change a saved code's name, content (merged into its data) or style. A dynamic code keeps working after printing; a static one changes its picture.

tools.name: delete_qr_code
tools.description: Delete a saved QR code (and, for a dynamic one, its short link).

tools.name: qr_code_stats
tools.description: Scans of a dynamic QR code: people, unique visitors, bots; on Pro+ daily series, countries, cities, devices, OS, browsers, a weekday-by-hour heatmap, week over week, the last hour and the latest scans.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The signed-in account, its plan and this month's usage.

tools.name: redeem_credit_code
tools.description: Redeem a wx93 credit code (CR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) on the signed-in account. It adds days of the Pro plan.

tools.name: list_invites
tools.description: The signed-in account's invite links: how many are left (3 per account) and which were used.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Make one invite link (single use, 30 days). A new account that signs up through it gets a week of Pro, and so does the inviter. The link is shown once.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Your webhook endpoints and the event types wx93 sends (link.created, link.clicked).

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Have wx93 POST link events to an https URL (Automation plan): link.created when a link is made, link.clicked on every human click. Deliveries are signed CloudEvents (Standard Webhooks headers, plus x-wx93-signature). Returns the signing secret once. events: link.created, link.clicked, link.* or *; o

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Change a webhook endpoint: url, events, description, or enabled (true turns a switched-off endpoint back on).

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a webhook.test event to an endpoint now and say how it went.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Replace an endpoint's signing secret. Returns the new one; the old one stops working at once.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Remove a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Recent webhook deliveries with their payloads and results, for one endpoint or all of them.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorten_url, create_qr_code · Private data: create_qr_code, create_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: create_qr_code, list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, test_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, delete_webhook, webhook_deliveries · Destructive: delete_link, delete_qr_code, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorten_url, create_qr_code · Private data: create_qr_code, create_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: create_qr_code, list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, test_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, delete_webhook, webhook_deliveries · Destructive: delete_link, delete_qr_code, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
